answer: What survives to the haven is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. Each submission hangs on the fable of a task receipt, and the prism is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
